## Disposition

Accept five scoped mathematical results for target 30004454. The original finite-rank infinite-Coxeter automorphism-quotient target remains unresolved after 5/5 substantive approaches. No sixth approach, full candidate, counterexample to the full conjecture, or novelty certification is claimed.

The unchanged proofs establish invariant-kernel quotient criteria, a finite-centralizer clique-overlap bound, an exact surjective direct-factor reduction, a retraction/unique-conjugator obstruction, and a standard reflection-implementation obstruction. The last two defeat proposed mechanisms, not the full conjecture. The factor reduction requires the full stabilizer's surjection, not merely a finite-index image.

## Current-source and acceptance boundaries

Varghese's published 2026 paper controls the hypotheses and numbering: the full target remains Conjecture 1.2; Theorem 1.4 requires a nonspherical odd factor with finite outer automorphism group or a disconnected finite-edge graph; Corollary 1.5 covers infinite even groups. Label-2 edges are retained. The historical incomplete centerless-clique theorem is not used as a proved input. Source searches are bounded, with no global priority or unsolved-status certificate.

All five proof files and the source audit remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The full independent mathematical audit and correction note follow labeled portable-context preambles. No mathematical theorem correction was needed. The original checker used 11 optimization-disabled assertions; the 12 false PASS observations from its earlier five-mode audit are historical only. The assertion-only original, old harness and full legacy packet are excluded; portable original replay is NOT_RUN.

## Fresh portable verification

The hardened checker is unchanged and preserves the original arithmetic predicates through explicit exceptions. The unchanged independent verifier makes 6066 exact checks, including 626 small cyclic graphs. Normal, -O and -OO each reject all 14 independent and 3 hardened semantic mutations at their intended conditions.

The fixed external bootstrap binds the entire delivered inventory, acceptance and pre-seal receipts. Fresh final controls passed at actual UID=EUID=1000 with files 0444 and directory 0555. Per mode: 17 mathematical negatives, 68 integrity negatives, 79 schema/scope negatives, 39 direct comparator negatives, 52 whole-delivery physical write denials, 6 fixture denials and 38 further denials within 19 mathematical subprocesses. Hostile import/environment execution matches the entire baseline output. Whole-delivery and fixture before/after hashes are unchanged.

Full stdout/stderr are compared byte-for-byte against mode-specific pinned references without normalization. JSON outputs also receive recursive type-exact comparison; the hardened checker's text output is exact bytes. Finite support checks do not replace the universal written arguments or constitute proof-assistant certification.

Pre-seal receipts are labeled and bound by the final manifest. Final fixed-bootstrap receipts are external to the delivery to avoid circular self-hashing. Original-checker/historical-harness/historical-five-mode replay, source-body replay, new source search, dataset replay and formal proof-assistant verification are NOT_RUN.
